title.narrative: Traders and Creatives Taking Inclusive Oversight Now - for Good Governance

description.narrative: TRACTION (Traders and Creatives Taking Inclusive Oversight Now — for good governance) is a seven-month initiative designed to build the capacity of informal traders and creatives to become leading agents of good governance and human rights. Its overall goal/impact is to strengthen informal traders' and creatives' voices and agencies to report, expose, engage, and hold duty-bearers accountable for inclusive governance that supports dignified livelihoods. TRACTION focuses on informal trade and creative economy due to its significant contribution to the economy and providing sources of livelihoods to millions of people, particularly women and youth. Yet, the people who are actively engaged in these two essential economies are systematically excluded from governance spaces. They face weak bargaining power and voice, and are rarely involved in policy or governance processes, including policy and budget-making. The absence of structured civic spaces for voice and access to information, even as they face corruption and gender-based exploitation, further entrenches their marginalization in governance and rights violations.
